sections.title: Meeting someone
sections.content: You know *mucho* *gusto* and *encantado* or *encantada* from Unit 1. Use them to answer when someone introduces you to a new person. You can also use *presentar* to introduce another person.

sections.title: Useful patterns
rows: Let me introduce Meg to you.

sections.content: *Mucho* *gusto* is a fixed expression. *Encantado* and *encantada* change according to the speaker, not the person being introduced.
